description: List the current branch and office locations of FDIC-insured banks: street address, city, state, ZIP, county, latitude/longitude, main-office flag, service type (full service, limited, etc.), and the date the office was established. Filter by FDIC certificate number (CERT), bank name, state, and/or city. Answers "where are Sturgis Bank & Trust's branches" and "all bank branches in Ottumwa, Iowa". Source: FDIC, BankFind institution locations. Use fdic_search_institutions to find a CERT from a name.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (e.g. "14413" for Iowa State Bank and Trust Company of Fairfield)

name.description: Bank name fragment (e.g. "Sturgis Bank"). Used when cert is not known.

name: fdic_branches
